cc:Work.dc:description: The artwork on a dark rounded tile, for places that need a finished icon without Icon Composer. XCommander's artwork: a captain's tricorne with ⌘ on its crown, over two crossed sabres that form an X. Created by Wassim Mansouri in Inkscape.
